newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA BOURSES' REPO TURNOVER HITS ALL-TIME HIGH.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA BOURSES' REPO TURNOVER HITS ALL-TIME HIGH.

text.p: An all-time high repo turnover of a total of 23.619 million levs, up from 16.2 billion levs in July, was registered on the two Bulgarian bourses on Friday as only one corporate issue traded, brokers said.
"Brokers focused on treasury paper attracted by the high yield under the current record high main rate," saiod a broker.
The central bank raised its central interest rate to 25 percent monthly or 300 percent annually from 108 percent, effective Tuesday.

The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Thursday's 41.02 points as only Varna Grand Hotel shares traded on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) at 87 levs, flat from Thursday's close and below par of 100.
Total stock turnover amounted to 4,350 levs and traded volumes was 50 stocks.
